plate.purpose: Title on a photo-less recipe tile, condensed, up to 4 lines.

title.purpose: Panel, dialog, focus-bar, empty-state and suggestion-shelf titles.

entry.purpose: Recipe titles in rows, pick rows, day-row main lines and tiles, 2-line clamp.

small.purpose: Meta, controls, field labels; slip section names (700) and the slip amount column (650).

label.purpose: Engraved word beside a control or value; lowercase only for single words.

plate-small.purpose: Title plate on a photo-less suggestion-shelf tile, up to 3 lines.

day-number.purpose: Day of the month in a week day row, tabular.

step-number.purpose: Kochmodus step number, tabular, followed by a "von n" label.

step-text.purpose: Kochmodus step, read at 50–80cm; sized by length (≤150 / ≤260 / longer chars: 30 / 34 / 38ch, down to 1.375rem); grows on tablets.

cook-ingredient.purpose: Kochmodus ingredient rows; amount 750 ink, unit 600 ink-2.

mono.purpose: System monospace for the API key (0.9375rem/600), its prefix (0.875rem, ink-2) and setup snippets (0.8125rem/1.5) only.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Popover menus only (account, overflow, entry menu, slip line menu). Never on cards or panels.

shadows.name: power-focus
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on the bottom-bar power disc.

shadows.name: led-knockout
shadows.purpose: A solid ring in the ground colour that separates an LED from the edge or line behind it. Not elevation.

motion.name: t-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, press, LED and switch state.

motion.name: t-mid
motion.purpose: Toast entry; a day-key, route-station or program LED lighting up.

motion.name: amount-lit
motion.purpose: Rescaled amount flashes green-ink and settles 2px.

motion.name: flap
motion.value: 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); from perspective(420px) rotateX(-72deg), opacity 0.35; transform-origin top
motion.purpose: Woche signature: a newly picked entry title, and the plan-bar readout when the selected day changes. Not on first paint; instant under reduced motion.

motion.name: strike
motion.purpose: Einkauf signature: a ticked slip line is struck through in place; text turns ink-2.

motion.name: feed
motion.purpose: A slip line printed since the last visit feeds in where it belongs.

motion.name: fold
motion.purpose: A finished slip section collapses under its rule once the last strike has played. Sections finished on arrival start folded, without motion.

motion.name: cook-slide
motion.purpose: Kochmodus signature: the next or previous screen turns in from its side while the program LED moves on. The only animated position change in the system.

motion.name: cook-guard
motion.purpose: Minimum time between two Kochmodus page turns, so a double tap never skips a step.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions and animations under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: cook-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: the Kochmodus wake text hides in the bar; a hint line appears when the screen may turn off.

breakpoints.name: keys-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: plan bar side padding drops to 12px, key gap to 3px.

breakpoints.name: form
breakpoints.purpose: Save moves into focus bar; ingredient row goes single-line.

breakpoints.name: rail
breakpoints.purpose: Rail replaces bars; list becomes aside + grid; the planning week becomes a pinned column beside the library.

breakpoints.name: cook-split
breakpoints.purpose: Kochmodus step splits 3fr / minmax(280px, 2fr); full ingredient list under the step panel; larger step text.

components.name: Power Button
components.description: The one green control: adds a recipe from anywhere; lifts out of the bottom bar.
components.css: .ds-power { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--on-green, #fff); text-decoration: none; } .ds-power__disc { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 58px; height: 58px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green, #2f7a43); outline: 5px solid var(--panel, #f4f5f2); transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-power:active .ds-power__disc { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-power:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-power:focus-visible .ds-power__disc { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--orange, #e0661f); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Green pill for the view's primary action (Speichern, Rezept lesen).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn--primary">Speichern</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel, #f4f5f2); color: var(--ink, #1f2022); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 620; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #e0661f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn--primary { background: var(--green, #2f7a43); border-color: transparent; color: var(--on-green, #fff); } .ds-btn--primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--green, #2f7a43) 88%, var(--ink, #1f2022)); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Panel pill with seam border for secondary actions (Kochen, Abbrechen).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn2">Kochen</button>
components.css: .ds-btn2 { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel, #f4f5f2); color: var(--ink, #1f2022); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 620; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn2:hover { background: var(--slot, #dcddd9); } .ds-btn2:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #e0661f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rocker Switch
components.description: Binary filter switch: LED window | seam | label half; on = pressed label half + orange LED. Distinct from chips.
components.css: .ds-rocker { display: inline-flex; align-items: stretch; min-height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--panel, #f4f5f2); color: var(--ink-2, #45484b); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; } .ds-rocker__window { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; border-right: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); background: var(--slot, #dcddd9); } .ds-rocker__led { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--led-off, #c2c4bf); transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-rocker__label { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 9px 0 8px; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-rocker[data-on] { color: var(--ink, #1f2022); } .ds-rocker[data-on] .ds-rocker__label, .ds-rocker:active .ds-rocker__label { background: var(--slot-strong, #d0d2cd); } .ds-rocker[data-on] .ds-rocker__led { background: var(--orange, #e0661f); } .ds-rocker:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #e0661f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Multi-select / sort choice; pressed = ink fill. 44px under coarse pointers.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel, #f4f5f2); color: var(--ink-2, #45484b); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 560; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--slot, #dcddd9); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--ink, #1f2022); border-color: var(--ink, #1f2022); color: var(--body, #e8e9e6); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #e0661f); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Search Slot
components.description: Recessed input in the appliance body; orange focus outline.
components.html: <label class="ds-slot"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input class="ds-slot__input" type="search" placeholder="Name oder Zutat"></label>
components.css: .ds-slot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 12px 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--slot, #dcddd9); color: var(--label, #5b5e61); } .ds-slot:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #e0661f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-slot__input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1f2022); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-slot__input:focus { outline: none; } .ds-slot__input::placeholder { color: var(--label, #5b5e61); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Recipe Tile with Title Plate
components.description: Desktop recipe tile; photo-less recipes get a deliberate title plate on the panel tone.
components.html:
Käsespätzle mit Röstzwiebeln 7×
zuletzt vor 3 Monaten40 min
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 240px; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--panel, #f4f5f2); color: var(--ink, #1f2022); text-decoration: none; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tile:hover { border-color: var(--label, #5b5e61); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #e0661f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tile__plate { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; padding: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); } .ds-tile__plate-title { font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 720; line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 88; text-wrap: balance; hyphens: auto; } .ds-tile__foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; padding: 12px 16px 16px; } .ds-tile__meta { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-2, #45484b); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tile__time { font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-leds { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-leds i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--led-off, #c2c4bf); } .ds-leds i[data-on] { background: var(--led-green, #3fae5c); }

components.name: Segmented Switch
components.description: One-of-n choice (meal slot, difficulty, theme); selected = ink fill.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; width: 320px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--slot, #dcddd9); } .ds-seg button { flex: 1; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #45484b); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-seg button[aria-checked='true'] { background: var(--ink, #1f2022); color: var(--body, #e8e9e6); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #e0661f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bottom Bar
components.description: Phone navigation: Woche · Rezepte · power ＋ · Einkauf; active = ink text + orange dot.
components.html: WocheRezepteEinkauf
components.css: .ds-bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); align-items: center; width: 390px; height: 68px; margin-top: 24px; background: var(--panel, #f4f5f2); border-top: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-bar__item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100%; color: var(--label, #5b5e61); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 560; } .ds-bar__item::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 7px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; } .ds-bar__item:hover { color: var(--ink, #1f2022); } .ds-bar__item.is-active { color: var(--ink, #1f2022); } .ds-bar__item.is-active::before { background: var(--orange, #e0661f); } .ds-bar__item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #e0661f); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-bar__power { justify-self: center; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 58px; height: 58px; margin-top: -22px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green, #2f7a43); color: var(--on-green, #fff); outline: 5px solid var(--panel, #f4f5f2); }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Ink bar with LED and optional undo; sits above the bottom bar.
components.html: Für morgen, Abendessen geplant.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 380px; min-height: 52px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--ink, #1f2022); color: var(--body, #e8e9e6); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 560; } .ds-toast__led { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--led-green, #3fae5c); flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-toast__msg { flex: 1; } .ds-toast__undo { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toast__undo:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--body, #e8e9e6) 12%, transparent); } .ds-toast__undo:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #e0661f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Week Day Row
components.description: One of seven fixed hairline rows: 52px date column, main slot line, side + line, lowercase other-slot line; today = orange dot; selected (planning) = slot fill + orange pointer.
components.html:
1. Mo16
  2. Di17
  3. Mi18
components.css: .ds-wdays { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 390px; border-top: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #1f2022); } .ds-wday { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 52px 1fr; gap: 8px; min-height: 76px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); } .ds-wday[data-selected] { background: var(--slot, #dcddd9); } .ds-wday__date { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; padding: 12px 0 12px 12px; } .ds-wday__wd { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; color: var(--ink-2, #45484b); } .ds-wday[data-today] .ds-wday__wd::after { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; margin-left: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--orange, #e0661f); vertical-align: 0.15em; } .ds-wday__num { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-wday[data-selected] .ds-wday__date::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12px; bottom: 10px; width: 14px; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--orange, #e0661f); } .ds-wday__body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; padding: 8px 8px 8px 0; } .ds-went, .ds-wday__free { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 4px 0 4px 8px; margin-left: -8px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-went:hover, .ds-wday__free:hover { background: var(--slot, #dcddd9); } .ds-went:focus-visible, .ds-wday__free:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #e0661f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-went__title { flex: 1; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 620; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-went__time { min-width: 4.2em; text-align: right; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-went--small { min-height: 36px; } .ds-went--small .ds-went__title { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 560; color: var(--ink-2, #45484b); } .ds-went--small .ds-went__time { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-2, #45484b); } .ds-went__plus { width: 0.9em; color: var(--label, #5b5e61); font-weight: 650; } .ds-label { min-width: 3.4em; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 560; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 88; color: var(--label, #5b5e61); } .ds-wday__free { width: 100%; color: var(--label, #5b5e61); font-weight: 560; } .ds-wday__hint { margin-left: auto; padding-right: 8px; color: var(--green-ink, #276a39); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 620; }

components.name: Day Keys
components.description: Seven panel keys across (weekday, number, LED); selected = pressed in slot-strong + orange 14x3 pointer; today = orange-ink weekday; past = body tone.
components.css: .ds-keys { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 4px; width: 358px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--body, #e8e9e6); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); } .ds-key { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1px; min-height: 60px; padding: 6px 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--panel, #f4f5f2); color: var(--ink, #1f2022); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-key__wd { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2, #45484b); } .ds-key__num { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-key__led { width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-top: 3px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--led-off, #c2c4bf); transition: background 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-key[data-filled] .ds-key__led { background: var(--led-green, #3fae5c); } .ds-key[data-today] .ds-key__wd { color: var(--orange-ink, #a3420b); } .ds-key[data-past] { color: var(--ink-2, #45484b); background: var(--body, #e8e9e6); } .ds-key:active { background: var(--slot-strong, #d0d2cd); } .ds-key[aria-checked='true'] { background: var(--slot-strong, #d0d2cd); border-color: var(--slot-strong, #d0d2cd); } .ds-key[aria-checked='true']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 3px; left: 50%; width: 14px; height: 3px; margin-left: -7px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--orange, #e0661f); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #e0661f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Suggestion Shelf Tile
components.description: 148px (168px desktop) panel tile in a snap rail; photo or Plate-small title plate; LED ramp + time; the shelf states its reason under its title.
components.html:
Lange nicht gegessen

Gut bewertet, seit 6 Wochen nicht gekocht
components.css: .ds-shelf { width: 390px; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #1f2022); } .ds-shelf__title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-shelf__why { display: block; margin: 2px 0 12px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 560; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 88; color: var(--label, #5b5e61); } .ds-shelf__rail { list-style: none; display: flex; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 2px 0 6px; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scrollbar-width: none; } .ds-shelf__rail > li { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; scroll-snap-align: start; } .ds-stile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 148px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--panel, #f4f5f2); color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: left; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-stile:hover { border-color: var(--label, #5b5e61); } .ds-stile:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-stile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #e0661f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-stile__plate { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; padding: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); font-size: 1.1875rem; font-weight: 720; line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 88; text-wrap: balance; hyphens: auto; } .ds-stile__meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-leds { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-leds i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--led-off, #c2c4bf); } .ds-leds i[data-on] { background: var(--led-green, #3fae5c); }

components.name: Shopping Slip
components.description: The printed slip: dashed section rules with open count, tabular amount column, lines struck through in place, a "haben wir" button on every open line, finished sections fold to one line.
components.html: Obst & Gemüse2
components.css: .ds-slip { width: 390px; padding: 2px 16px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #c6c8c3); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--panel, #f4f5f2); color: var(--ink, #1f2022); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-slip__head { margin: 0; font: inherit; } .ds-slip__rule { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 16px 0 4px; } .ds-slip__rule--btn { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-slip__rule--btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #e0661f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-slip__name { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-slip__dots { flex: 1; min-width: 12px; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--seam, #c6c8c3); transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-slip__count { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; color: var(--ink-2, #45484b); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-slip__done { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--label, #5b5e61); } .ds-slip__rule--btn:hover .ds-slip__done { color: var(--ink, #1f2022); } .ds-slip__lines { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-sline { display: flex; align-items: stretch; } .ds-sline__tap { flex: 1; narrative.overview:
Essensplan is a quiet, precise kitchen appliance in the Braun/Rams line. A matte grey body carries a few controls, and each one is tactile and exactly labelled: a recessed search slot, rocker switches with an LED window, a servings dial with a printed scale, and one green power button that adds a recipe from anywhere. The tone is calm and utilitarian. The controls are where the fun lives.

The appliance comes from geometry, proportion and control behaviour. There is no faked material. Surfaces are flat tones separated by 1px hairline seams. Depth comes from tone: panels sit raised and slots sit recessed. Status is shown with LED dots. Times and amounts use tabular figures. One sober grotesk (Archivo, with variable width) does all the work, from large condensed titles down to small engraved device labels. The dark theme is the black version of the same appliance. It uses the same geometry with the tones inverted.

Content stays dense and calm. The phone gets quiet hairline rows. Wider screens get a grid in which photos show as photos, and a recipe without a photo gets a deliberate title plate instead of a placeholder. The week is the appliance's program panel: seven fixed day rows that fold into a row of seven day keys while planning. The shopping list is the slip the appliance prints: one narrow strip in the store's order, struck through line by line where it stands. Kochmodus runs a recipe as the appliance's program: one step on the display at a time, set large enough to read from across the counter. The system rejects the category default of photo-card grids, shadowed cards and a stock-blue accent.
keyCharacteristics: Matte grey body, raised panels, recessed slots, hairline seams (1px).
One signal green for "on" and the primary action. One orange for the single active or favourite marker.
LED dots for status and the single "how loved" scale.
One grotesk on the width axis: condensed display titles, small tracked device labels, tabular figures.
Round, tactile controls with touch targets of at least 44px.
Content changes in place: rows and lines never move. A day's entry flips like a split-flap, and a bought item is struck through where it stands.

rules.name: The One Marker Rule
rules.body: Orange marks state only: what is active, selected, favoured or focused. It is never an action colour. No button, link or fill that triggers an action is orange.

rules.name: The Power Rule
rules.body: Green means "on" and the primary action. Each view has one green filled control. In the shell that control is the power ＋.

rules.name: The Ink Variant Rule
rules.body: Green and orange reach contrast as fills. When text needs either colour, use `green-ink` or `orange-ink`.

rules.name: The Pointer Rule
rules.body: The one current thing carries exactly one orange pointer: a 14×3px bar with 2px corners. It sits under the selected day (key or row) while planning, under the current station of the route rail, and under the current screen of the Kochmodus program row. When a program is finished, every LED is lit and the pointer disappears. Today is a different mark (an orange dot in rows, `orange-ink` weekday text on keys), so "current" and "today" never read as the same signal.

rules.name: The Multi-Select Rule
rules.body: When a control chooses several things at once (chips, the days of a shopping trip), "chosen" is shown by the pressed or lit state alone. Multi-select controls never carry the pointer, because there is no single current one.

rules.name: The Device Label Rule
rules.body: A device label names a control or a value: zeit, gekocht, zuletzt, bewertung, sortierung, kategorie, portionen, folgt, optional, heute, and the short slot names (früh, abend, snack) that lead secondary entry lines. A single-word device label is lowercase. Every other label, hint or sentence uses normal German orthography ("Link zum Rezept", "Ein Konto für die ganze Familie"). Never use uppercase or small caps.

rules.name: The Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only for an API key, its prefix and setup snippets. Everything a person reads stays in Archivo.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Never put a label above a heading. Headings stand alone. Labels belong to controls, fields, Steckbrief values and ingredient groups. A shelf's reason sits under its title, never above it.

rules.name: The Figure Rule
rules.body: Times, amounts, counts, day numbers, step numbers, section counts on the slip and the dial readout use tabular figures (`tnum`). Shopping amounts and Kochmodus amounts sit in a right-aligned 5.5em column. A time is a first-class figure, right-aligned and set at 650 weight.

rules.name: The Seam Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with a 1px `seam` hairline and a change of tone. A shadow is allowed only on something that actually floats above the page.

rules.name: The Split-Flap Rule
rules.body: Rows and lines never move, reorder or slide. Change happens in place: an entry flips, a bought line is struck through, a new line feeds in where it belongs, and a finished section folds under its own rule. Only the element that changed moves. Kochmodus is a pager, not a list: there the whole screen turns (see Kochmodus).

dos: **Do** separate surfaces with 1px `seam` hairlines and tone. Panels are raised and slots are recessed.
**Do** keep every interactive target at least 44px (`tap`). Controls that are smaller on fine pointers grow to 44px under `pointer: coarse`.
**Do** give a recipe without a photo a deliberate title plate on the panel tone, set in Plate type (Plate small on shelf tiles).
**Do** use the LED ramp as the only rating and "how loved" display, and use the same ramp everywhere.
**Do** set times, amounts and counts in tabular figures, with times right-aligned.
**Do** use lowercase only for single-word device labels, and normal German orthography everywhere else.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion`. Every transition and animation drops to 0ms.
**Do** keep the week as seven fixed rows or seven keys. Show a change by flipping the content in place, never by moving rows.
**Do** mark the one current thing (the selected day, the current route station) with the orange pointer bar, and today with the orange dot or the `orange-ink` weekday.
**Do** show a multi-select choice by pressing the key alone, without the pointer.
**Do** strike a bought line through where it stands, and fold a finished section under its own rule.
**Do** set Kochmodus for reading at 50–80cm: step numbers at 3rem, step text never below 1.375rem, ingredient rows at 1.25rem.
**Do** keep real, focusable navigation buttons wherever a whole-screen tap zone moves the content.
**Do** light an LED for what an agent did that you have not seen yet (avatar dot, "n neu", activity rows), and offer "Rückgängig" in the log instead of asking for confirmation up front.
**Do** list rights that can do harm in `danger-ink`, wherever they appear.
donts: **Don't** put kicker or eyebrow labels above headings.
**Don't** use orange for an action. It marks the single active, favourite or focused thing.
**Don't** draw rockers as ink-filled pills. A rocker is LED window, seam and pressed label half. Ink fill belongs to chips and segments.
**Don't** put shadows on cards or panels. The Float shadow is only for popover menus.
**Don't** fake material: no bevels, textures, embossing, or decorative or placeholder gradients on surfaces.
**Don't** use the old stock blue, or any accent other than green and orange.
**Don't** use a gradient or icon placeholder in place of a missing photo.
**Don't** confirm a pick with a toast, sheet or dialog. The flap, the LED and the last-pick line are the feedback.

**Don't** animate position. Rows and lines never move, reorder or slide; motion only flips, strikes, feeds or folds content in place. The one exception is a whole Kochmodus screen, which turns with a 24px slide.
**Don't** set anything a person reads in monospace. Mono is for the key, its prefix and setup snippets only.
**Don't** fake paper on the slip: no texture, torn edges or receipt font. It is the panel tone with dashed seams.
